payload.claim: The 'Fetch little' paragraph justifies an optimization (list origin's branches once, walk newest-first, stop at the first qualifying) with 'Measured off base, in the home ledger on 2026-10-23: 262 tasks carry a pushed sha, 248 of them MERGED, and most of their branches are deleted' — a claim about an operator-side ledger database not present in this repository snapshot, so it cannot be checked against the tree at hand. It only motivates a performance-shaping instruction, not a correctness criterion.
